capabilities: define flashcards in Markdown files with braincache syntax
include images that are uploaded to the braincache server
log in via an Obsidian token from braincache settings
sync local cards with a braincache account using a ribbon button or sync command
extras: The README warns the plugin is in an extremely early stage of development and asks users to report bugs as issues.
motivation: The README calls it a companion plugin for braincache, implying it exists to connect Obsidian to that service, but gives no further reason.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn note content into flashcards on the braincache service.

relations.evidence: This is a companion plugin for braincache

summary: Flashcard companion plugin that creates braincache flashcards from Markdown files and syncs them to a braincache account.
